summary: Handheld controller-style split housing: two moulded shells joined by four screws (an original design)
assumptions: Original shape, not a copy of any product: a rounded slab with a grip lobe at each end.
Screws from below through counterbored holes in the lower shell into bosses in the upper shell.

subassemblies.name: Controller housing
subassemblies.description: Lower and upper shell screwed together on the split line.

parts.name: Lower shell
parts.description: Moulded ABS lower shell 150 x 95 x 18 mm, 2 mm wall, a grip lobe at each end, four Ø3.4 screw holes counterbored Ø8 x 9 from below (in Ø11 bosses), flat split face on top.

parts.name: Upper shell
parts.description: Moulded ABS upper shell 150 x 95 x 14 mm, 2 mm wall, four Ø7 bosses tapped M3 (Ø2.5) from the split face.

parts.name: Shell screw M3x16
parts.description: ISO 4762 socket head cap screw M3 x 16 from below through the lower shell into the upper shell bosses.
